days.title: Between Periods
days.tagline: It's intermission and the ice is wrecked. Steer the machine, ration your water, and buff every scar before the buzzer.
days.description: It is intermission and the rink is a wreck: skate grooves, divots and one seeded mishap. Steer an ice-resurfacing machine that cannot turn on a dime, ration one tank of water, and buff every scar to a mirror gleam before the buzzer. Every UTC day brings its own rink, and your finish becomes a spoiler-safe postcard and a challenge link a friend can try to beat.

days.title: Orbital Knitwear
days.tagline: Tune a satellite's orbit and knit the planet in wool, one pass at a time, while the flat map lies about the holes.
days.description: Tune a satellite's height, tilt and orbit shape and watch its ground track knit a wool-textured world map, one ribbon of stitches per pass, in a flat or a polar view. Eight pattern cards set goals such as seeing latitudes the space station never reaches, repeating the same track every 16 days, or keeping one local time of day. Scores count true surface area, so the map's inflated poles cannot flatter you.

days.title: Jokers In Phase
days.tagline: Five jokers, one beat. Swap them into step, lock three fireflies in phase, and beat par.
days.description: An unofficial fan concept sandbox for joker-deck roguelikes where jokers have a beat. Arrange five jokers over four seeded poker hands, watch a phase ring show who is in sync, and share the exact line as a link.
